extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: civil research submarine (submersible) on its landing skids, approx. 7.6 x 3.2 x 3.6 m (L x W x H), hull diameter 2.3 m
extras.notes: front (viewing dome) faces -Y; stands on two skids at z = 0 (no water needed, it is a submersible); friendly civil design, no weapons; separate moving parts with origin on their axis: submarine_propeller (inside the duct, spins around the long axis), submarine_dive_plane_aft_port / _starboard and submarine_dive_plane_bow_port / _starboard (pitch around X), submarine_rudder_top / _bottom (turn around Z), submarine_hatch (opens around its rear hinge, X); opaque tinted dome and portholes, no interior; no brand, no text, no number

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
